description: Header file defining a template class StreamJSONOneShotType for streaming JSON data with a one-shot parse approach, including internal serializer and deserializer implementations, within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: StreamJSONOneShotType
classes.description: Template class providing a one-shot streaming JSON parser with internal serializer and deserializer, designed for use within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: SerializerImpl
classes.description: Internal class handling serialization of INTERFACE objects into a stream, with support for JSON and MessagePack formats.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Internal class handling deserialization of incoming streams into INTERFACE objects, with support for JSON and MessagePack formats.

classes.name: HandlerType
classes.description: Internal class extending SOURCE to handle data transmission and reception, passing calls to the parent class.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a reference to the internal channel handler.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle received INTERFACE elements.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send INTERFACE elements.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle state changes.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an INTERFACE element for transmission if the channel is open.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the channel is suspended.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Serializes data to be sent over the channel.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Deserializes received data from the channel.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks if both serializer and deserializer are idle.
